item.title: Over nine feared dead after sleeper coach bus catches fire in Karnataka collision
item.description: At least nine passengers are feared to have been burned alive after a sleeper coach bus caught fire following a collision with a speeding truck in Karnataka’s Chitradurga district in the early hours of Christmas Day.

item.title: PFAS row erupts over Ratnagiri chemical plant machinery in Maharashtra
item.description: Political and environmental controversy erupts in Maharashtra’s Ratnagiri as NCP (SP) MLA Rohit Pawar alleges a chemical plant is using machinery from a controversial Italian firm linked to toxic PFAS chemicals, emitting harmful compounds.

item.title: Epstein files release delayed as US DoJ finds over a million additional records
item.description: The US Justice Department says it may need “a few more weeks” to release all records linked to late sex offender Jeffrey Epstein after discovering over a million additional documents, delaying a congressionally mandated deadline.

item.title: North Korea showcases progress on nuclear-powered submarine as Kim criticises South
item.description: North Korea has signalled progress on a nuclear-powered submarine, releasing state media images showing a largely completed vessel, as Kim Jong Un criticised South Korea’s efforts to acquire similar technology

item.title: Faithful flock Bethlehem, Pope Leo XIV celebrates his first Christmas Eve mass
item.description: After years of war and silence, lights, music and hope filled Manger Square once again. From the #HolyLand to the #Vatican, #Christmas celebrations reflected resilience, faith and a cautious return to normal life.

item.title: Powerful winter storm lashes California, triggering floods and evacuations
item.description: A powerful winter storm swept across California on Wednesday, bringing torrential rain and strong winds that triggered mudslides, flooding and evacuation orders, with authorities warning conditions could worsen over Christmas.

item.title: Karnataka crash: Tried to avoid oncoming truck but failed, says bus driver
item.description: The driver of the luxury sleeper bus involved in the deadly Chitradurga accident said he tried to control the vehicle after spotting an overspeeding truck approaching from the opposite direction, but was unable to avoid the collision.

item.title: First flight lands at Navi Mumbai international airport
item.description: The Navi Mumbai International Airport commenced commercial flight operations on Thursday, 25 December, marking a key milestone for India's civil aviation sector, while expanding air travel capacity for the Mumbai Metropolitan Region

item.title: Bangladesh BNP leader Tarique Rahman returns home after 17 years in exile
item.description: Tarique Rahman, acting chairman of the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP), returned to Bangladesh on Thursday after 17 years living in exile in London, arriving with his wife and daughter amid a tense security situation in the capital.

item.title: Anti-Christian violence and ‘anti-conversion’ laws make it a season of grim reflection
item.description: Despite EU concerns over escalating violence against Christians in India, the bloc is keen to revive its long-pending trade deal, overlooking reports of mob attacks, anti-conversion laws, and persecution across multiple states.
